comparison.objective: Tighten a fifteen-ball pool rack on the foot spot and lift the triangle away without disturbing the balls; candidate commissions and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Rack task tests collective planar compaction, careful bimanual rack manipulation, and straight clearance lift around many rolling bodies. Candidate tests tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, fastening force control, and dynamic-response interpretation.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires all 30 intended ball contacts within 0.5 mm, head ball within 5 mm of the spot, rack clear by 50 mm, no ball displaced over 3 mm during lift, and hands clear. Candidate uses energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Multi-object compaction and disturbance-free fixture removal do not test damper adjustment or locked-setting validation. Estimated ball friction and surrogate rolling resistance are missing calibration details but do not suggest duplication.
